recommended_modelling_workflow: Decompose leftspeedpod, rightfuel/gear pod, joined shell, bezels, clear lenses, pointers, odometer, USB cover, centrepanel, bracket and visor as separate objects.
Use INS02 as main visible layout guide. Fit a perspective camera and annotate circles/centres before deriving proportions; do not treat cropped photograph as an orthographic dimensional plan.
Choose any required working diameter/spacing/depth as explicit estimates with bounds; no part dimensions have been found.
Make original WEWA dial graphics from readable tick/number features; do not project photograph highlights, reflections, dust or manufacturer logo pixels onto a texture.
Build independent pointer pivots, currentgear lamp states and odometer/display changes for testing after source forms exist. Right dial is not a tachometer.
Use related exploded drawings only for plausible shell/bracket decomposition; preserve unobserved backside depth and exact fixing positions as unresolved.
Inspect isolated clean materials under neutral and grazing light, then compare actual Blender and Babylon buffers/render; leave art acceptance and iPhone qualification open.
